patch_description: Following the provided recommendation, merge the offset-YY entangling block into the nearest-neighbor entangler by changing each YY gate's parameter from "ent_off" to "ent_nn". This reduces the distinct parameter count from 7 to 6, concentrating gradient flow in fewer parameters for tighter optimization. The XX and YY gates both operate on adjacent qubits and can effectively share the same parameter. This should improve parameter efficiency while maintaining—or potentially enhancing—the worst_group_margin through more focused gradient updates during training.
